codes.label: EBICS_NO_ONLINE_CHECKS
codes.description: The bank does not support preliminary order checks, yet the EBICS request carries preliminary-check data.
causes: Online checking not enabled on the bank side
Client software sending unsupported preliminary-check data
codes.action: Disable preliminary-check data in the EBICS client software for this bank.

codes.label: EBICS_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
codes.description: EBICS authentication failed.
causes: Incorrect configuration of the client EBICS server
Invalid or revoked user ID
Authentication certificate not recognised by the bank
codes.action: Check the server configuration and the status of the user IDs. Expect to revoke and re-enrol the subscriber.

codes.label: EBICS_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED_REVOKED
codes.description: The authentication certificate in use has been revoked, either by the certification authority or by the bank.
causes: Reported key compromise
Employee departure with access rights removed
Revocation initiated by the bank
codes.action: Contact the bank to confirm the revocation, then fully reset the EBICS subscriber (new INI/HIA phase plus initialisation letter).

codes.label: EBICS_INTERNAL_ERROR
codes.description: Unspecified internal EBICS error.
causes: Missing element in the contract configuration (collection side)
Download file too large
codes.action: Check the contract configuration and the size of the download file.

codes.label: EBICS_DOWNLOAD_SIGNED_ONLY
codes.description: The bank requires download data to be signed, but the request was sent without a signature.
causes: EBICS mode set to T instead of TS
Incorrect order attributes in the request
Contract requiring a signature for certain download order types
codes.action: Check the configured EBICS mode (T versus TS) and the order attributes in the request.

codes.label: EBICS_NO_DOWNLOAD_DATA_AVAILABLE
codes.description: No data available for the requested download.
causes: File not yet made available by the bank
Publication time not reached
No movement to report for the requested period
codes.action: Check the file publication times with the bank — statements are often only available from 5 a.m., for instance.

codes.label: EBICS_AUTHORISATION_ORDER_TYPE_FAILED
codes.description: The requested order type is not authorised for this EBICS subscriber.
causes: Order type not enabled contractually for this user ID
Wrong request type in the request
Option missing from the bank-side configuration
codes.action: Check the request type and confirm that the option is present in the bank-side configuration.

codes.label: EBICS_INVALID_ORDER_DATA_FORMAT
codes.description: The order data submitted does not match the specified format.
causes: File format not compliant with the contract
Wrong XML schema version
Invalid payment file structure
codes.action: Check that the file format complies with the banking contract specifications.

codes.label: EBICS_NO_DOWNLOAD_DATA_AVAILABLE_COUNTER
codes.description: No data to download according to the consumption counter.
causes: Data already retrieved for the period
Consumption counter exhausted
Publication prerequisites not met
codes.action: Check the dates in the consumption counter and the publication prerequisites.

codes.label: EBICS_UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST_FOR_ORDER_INSTANCE
codes.description: For some business transactions, detailed order data cannot be extracted.
causes: Order type incompatible with detail extraction
VEU transaction that does not support this request
codes.action: Check that the order type is compatible with the request being made.

codes.label: EBICS_INVALID_SIGNATURE_FILE_FORMAT
codes.description: The electronic signature file is not in the format the server expects.
causes: Client EBICS protocol version incompatible with the contract (H003/H004/H005)
Outdated EBICS client software
Corrupted signature file
codes.action: Check that the EBICS client software produces signature files matching the protocol version set in the contract. Update it if necessary.

codes.label: EBICS_BANK_TECHNICAL_ERROR
codes.description: Internal technical error at the bank, unrelated to the client request.
causes: Banking platform incident
Unannounced maintenance
EBICS server overload
codes.action: Nothing to do on the client side. Contact the bank quoting the TransactionID of the request, then retry once they confirm.

codes.label: EBICS_SEGMENT_NUMBER_EXCEEDED
codes.description: The number of segments in the transaction exceeds the limit allowed by the bank server.
causes: File too large
Too many transactions in the batch
Bank server size limit reached
codes.action: Reduce the file size (fewer transactions per batch), or check the maximum size with the bank. Some banks accept up to 100 MB, others cap at 10 MB.

codes.label: EBICS_DOWNLOAD_SIGNED_ONLY_ORDER_ATTR
codes.description: The banking platform only accepts signed download data. The transaction is stopped when the subscriber sets the order attributes to DZHNN without an electronic signature.
causes: Order attribute DZHNN without a signature
EBICS contract requiring a signature for this download type
codes.action: Check the order attributes and enable the electronic signature for the downloads concerned.

codes.label: EBICS_INVALID_USER_OR_USER_STATE
codes.description: EBICS subscriber unknown to the bank, or subscriber state incompatible with the call being made.
causes: User ID missing from the banking contract
Configuration still in progress on the bank side
Subscriber not yet activated in production
codes.action: Check whether configuration is still in progress at the bank. If a user ID is live, run an HPB to see whether the subscriber responds. Check the state expected by the call.

codes.label: EBICS_USER_UNKNOWN
codes.description: EBICS subscriber unknown to the bank server.
causes: User ID does not exist in the banking contract
User ID deleted or deactivated
User ID mistyped in the client software
codes.action: Find out why the subscriber is missing from the banking contract and correct the configuration.

codes.label: EBICS_INVALID_USER_STATE
codes.description: The EBICS subscriber state is incompatible with the call being made.
causes: Subscriber not in production (enrolment incomplete)
Certificates not validated by the bank
INI/HIA phase not finalised
codes.action: Review the enrolment process. The subscriber is not live, or was enrolled incorrectly. Check that the bank has validated the certificates.

codes.label: EBICS_INVALID_ORDER_TYPE
codes.description: The order type is invalid or not subscribed to in the EBICS contract.
causes: Option not subscribed to in the contract
Wrong request type used
Order type incompatible with the subscriber profile
codes.action: Check that the option is present in the contract and that the request type is correct.

codes.label: EBICS_UNSUPPORTED_FILE_FORMAT
codes.description: The bank does not support the format of the submitted file.
causes: Wrong request type for the file version — for example pain.001.001.03 sent with an order type meant for pain.001.001.09
Format not enabled in the contract
Format migration not completed on the bank side
codes.action: Check both the request type and the format version the bank accepts. Very common during pain.001.001.03 → pain.001.001.09 migrations.

codes.label: EBICS_BANK_PUBKEY_UPDATE_REQUIRED
codes.description: The bank public keys have been renewed and must be updated on the client side.
causes: Periodic renewal of the bank certificates (every three to five years)
Banking platform migration
codes.action: Run an HPB (Download Bank Public Keys) from the EBICS client software. Nothing is required on the bank side.

codes.label: EBICS_BANK_PUBKEY_UPDATE_REQUIRED_V2
codes.description: Variant of 091007. The bank certificates have expired or been renewed.
causes: Bank certificates expired
Renewal not applied on the client side
codes.action: Run an HPB from the EBICS client software. If the problem persists, check that the software has actually picked up the new key hashes.

codes.label: EBICS_INVALID_XML
codes.description: XML file malformed, or not compliant with the expected schema.
causes: Invalid XML structure
Missing or unclosed tag
Wrong character encoding
Incorrect namespace
codes.action: Retrieve the file and run it through an XML validator. Correct the structure before submitting again.

codes.label: EBICS_TX_MESSAGE_REPLAY
codes.description: Inconsistency detected between the client server and the bank server — possibly a duplicate file.
causes: Duplicate file submitted
TransactionID already used
Certificates sent at enrolment inconsistent with the key usage configuration
codes.action: Check for duplicate files. Review the certificates sent at enrolment and the key usage configuration.

codes.label: EBICS_RECOVERY_NOT_SUPPORTED
codes.description: The bank does not support transaction recovery. The upload transaction is stopped.
causes: Recovery not enabled on the bank side
EBICS version that does not support recovery
codes.action: Do not use recovery with this bank. Restart the transaction from the beginning.

codes.label: EBICS_INVALID_SIGNATURE_FORMAT
codes.description: The electronic signature file submitted does not match the defined format.
causes: Signature format incompatible with the protocol version
Signature produced by outdated software
Corrupted signature file
codes.action: Check the signature file against the format defined in the EBICS contract.

codes.label: EBICS_ORDER_ID_UNKNOWN
codes.description: During verification, the bank found that the order was not part of the VEU processing system.
causes: OrderID does not exist in the bank's VEU system
Transaction expired
OrderID submitted incorrectly
codes.action: Check that the OrderID submitted matches an existing order in the VEU system.

codes.label: EBICS_ORDER_ID_ALREADY_EXISTS
codes.description: The OrderID submitted already exists in the banking system.
causes: Duplicate submission with the same OrderID
OrderID sequence not incremented by the client software
codes.action: Change the client EBICS server configuration by altering the OrderID letter or value.

codes.label: EBICS_PROCESSING_ERROR
codes.description: Processing error on the bank server.
causes: Internal incident on the banking platform
Request data causing the bank-side processing to fail
codes.action: Contact the bank quoting the TransactionID of the request (visible in the EBICS logs), then retry once they confirm.

codes.label: EBICS_ACCOUNT_AUTHORISATION_FAILED
codes.description: The account targeted by the submission is not authorised in the EBICS contract.
causes: Debtor account IBAN missing from the list of authorised accounts in the EBICS configuration
Account added recently without updating the EBICS contract
Wrong IBAN in the payment file
codes.action: Check with the bank that the account is listed in the EBICS contract. Ask for the configuration to be updated if it is not.

codes.label: EBICS_AMOUNT_CHECK_FAILED
codes.description: The total amount of the file exceeds the transfer ceiling set in the EBICS contract.
causes: Per-transaction ceiling exceeded
Per-file ceiling exceeded
Daily total above the contractual limit
codes.action: Short term: split the file into several submissions below the ceiling. Longer term: ask your account manager to review the ceilings.

codes.label: EBICS_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED_INVALID_SIGNATURE
codes.description: The electronic signature of the EBICS message is invalid or not recognised by the server.
causes: Authentication certificate (X002) expired or corrupted
Wrong pairing between the certificate and the EBICS subscriber
Private key out of sync with the public key held by the bank
codes.action: Check the expiry date of the authentication certificate and renew it via HCS if it has expired. As a last resort, reset the subscriber (INI/HIA).

codes.label: EBICS_DOWNLOAD_POSTPROCESS_DONE
codes.description: The download file has already been retrieved and marked as processed by the bank server.
causes: File already downloaded in an earlier session
Second download attempt for the same file
codes.action: Not blocking. If the file never arrived, check the earlier downloads in the EBICS software logs.

codes.label: EBICS_DOWNLOAD_POSTPROCESS_SKIPPED
codes.description: The bank server skipped the download post-processing step.
causes: No post-processing defined on the bank side for this file
codes.action: Not blocking. Nothing to do on the client side.

codes.label: EBICS_INVALID_REQUEST
codes.description: The EBICS request is malformed or carries incompatible parameters.
causes: Invalid request type / order attribute combination
Corrupted transaction segment
Protocol version mismatch (H003/H004/H005)
codes.action: Check the EBICS protocol version (H003/H004/H005) against the banking contract. Update the EBICS client software if a version migration is under way.

codes.label: EBICS_UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE
codes.description: The order type does not exist in the EBICS contract, or is not supported by this protocol version. Distinct from 091005 (option not subscribed to): here the order type itself is unknown to the server.
causes: Order type unknown to the server
Incompatibility between EBICS H004 and H005
Order type withdrawn during a banking platform migration
codes.action: Check the list of order types available in the contract and their compatibility with the EBICS version (H004 versus H005).

codes.label: EBICS_SEGMENT_SIZE_EXCEEDED
codes.description: A file segment exceeds the size allowed by the bank server.
causes: Segment larger than the maximum allowed, typically 1 MB
Incorrect segmentation settings in the EBICS client software
codes.action: Check the segmentation settings in the EBICS software against the server limits, and reduce the segment size.

codes.label: EBICS_X509_CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED
codes.description: The EBICS certificates in use have expired.
causes: Certificate expiry date passed
No automatic renewal procedure in place
codes.action: Renew the certificates and re-enrol the EBICS subscriber concerned.

codes.label: EBICS_X509_CERTIFICATE_NOT_VALID_YET
codes.description: The X.509 certificate is not valid yet — its start-of-validity date has not been reached.
causes: Clock drift between the client EBICS host and the bank EBICS server
Certificate issued with a future start-of-validity date
codes.action: Check NTP synchronisation on the machine running the EBICS client software, and correct the system time if needed.

codes.label: EBICS_X509_WRONG_KEY_USAGE
codes.description: The EBICS certificate was not issued for the requested use, or its Key Usage field is incorrect.
causes: Transport subscriber missing
Certificate not issued for the current use
Key Usage field unset or incorrect in the certificate
codes.action: Check that a transport subscriber exists and review the certificate's Key Usage field. This code only appears when key-management order types are used.

codes.label: EBICS_X509_UNKNOWN_CERTIFICATE_AUTHORITY
codes.description: The certification authority behind the certificate is unknown to the bank, or unsupported.
causes: Certificate issued by a CA not registered with the bank
Self-signed certificate, which is not accepted
Incomplete certificate chain
codes.action: Contact the bank for the list of accepted certification authorities. Either use a certificate from a recognised CA, or have yours registered.

codes.label: EBICS_ORDER_DATA_SEGMENT_MISSING_OR_INVALID
codes.description: A mandatory data segment in the EBICS order is missing or malformed.
causes: File truncated during transmission
Incorrect file encoding
XML structure not compliant with the EBICS schema
codes.action: Check the integrity and XML compliance of the file before submitting. Run it through an XML validator.

codes.label: EBICS_SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED
codes.description: Electronic signature verification failed.
causes: Migration from T to TS without revoking the transport subscriber
The server expects a signed file but the subscriber sent an unsigned one
Wrong or expired signing key
codes.action: Check the signature mode (T versus TS). When migrating, make sure the old transport subscriber was revoked before enabling the new mode.

codes.label: EBICS_INVALID_SIGNER_STATE
codes.description: The signer's state is invalid for this operation.
causes: The signer both transmitted and signed the file (roles combined)
Bank configuration forbidding the transport and signer roles to be combined
codes.action: Check the bank-side configuration. Separate the transport and signer roles if the contract requires it.
